part.name: Elongated rounded housing with blind axial socket
part.description: Single-piece solid body comprising an enlarged rounded rear housing, a long rectangular load-carrying spine, a shaped front nose, a blind cylindrical socket opening at the front end, and a lateral rectangular clearance or latch pocket.
part.symmetry_note: The main spine and axial socket are locally symmetric about the socket axis, but the complete part is asymmetric because of the enlarged rear housing, one-sided lateral pocket, and unequal external corner treatments.

Section.name: Main load-carrying spine
Section.function intent: Provides the primary structural connection between the enlarged rear housing and the front interface while presenting broad exterior guide and contact surfaces.
Section.physical behavior: Acts predominantly as a deep beam. Its widely separated top and bottom skins resist bending, the long side walls resist shear and torsion, and the edge blends reduce stress concentration along the section transitions.
Section.geometry: Long, mostly rectangular prismatic body extending along the part length. It has a broad planar top, planar side and underside regions, narrow inclined edge bands, and a cylindrical side transition near the front.
Section.location: Central and longitudinal portion of the part, extending from the rear housing toward the front nose.

major_faces.name: Broad top skin
major_faces.description: Largest planar upper surface, spanning the spine and much of the overall part footprint.

major_faces.name: Upper near-side bevel
major_faces.description: Long narrow inclined planar band joining the top skin to the near-side outer contour.

major_faces.name: Front-side cylindrical transition
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical outer patch forming the rounded side transition toward the shaped front region.

major_faces.name: Lower near-side bevel
major_faces.description: Long inclined planar band connecting the near-side wall region to the lower skin.

major_faces.name: Main underside
major_faces.description: Large planar lower surface of the elongated spine, locally interrupted by adjacent features.

major_faces.name: Far longitudinal side wall
major_faces.description: Large vertical planar side face extending along most of the spine length.

major_faces.name: Near longitudinal side wall
major_faces.description: Large planar side surface with an inner wire associated with the opening of the lateral pocket.

Section.name: Front interface nose
Section.function intent: Forms the terminal interface around the axial socket, protects the socket mouth, and transfers insertion or attachment loads into the main spine.
Section.physical behavior: The thick front wall reacts axial and transverse loads from a mating pin or shaft. Rounded and chamfered perimeter surfaces reduce edge damage and spread contact stresses into the spine.
Section.geometry: Shaped end region at the longitudinal front of the part, consisting of a planar end face pierced by the socket, a planar side flank, a large cylindrical corner, and several small cylindrical, conical, and inclined transition bands.
Section.location: Extreme front end of the elongated spine, surrounding the visible circular opening.

major_faces.name: Front-side planar flank
major_faces.description: Planar longitudinal flank immediately behind the terminal end and adjacent to the rounded front-side transition.

major_faces.name: Terminal socket face
major_faces.description: Planar end face at the maximum longitudinal extent, containing the circular opening of the blind socket.

major_faces.name: Outer nose corner
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical corner patch rounding the outer front edge between the end and adjacent side surfaces.

Section.name: Enlarged rounded rear housing
Section.function intent: Provides an enlarged reaction, grip, stop, or mounting body at the rear of the part and spreads loads received from the narrower spine over a larger volume.
Section.physical behavior: The increased section depth and width raise bending and bearing capacity. Large-radius cylindrical and spherical corners distribute stress, improve impact tolerance, and remove sharp external edges.
Section.geometry: Bulky, approximately rectangular rear body with planar central facets and heavily rounded vertical, lower, and compound corners. The housing joins the narrower spine through a stepped shoulder.
Section.location: Rear end of the part, opposite the circular socket opening.

major_faces.name: Rear lower-side planar facet
major_faces.description: Rectangular planar facet forming part of the rear housing side between adjacent rounded corners.

major_faces.name: Rear lower vertical round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical patch rounding one lower vertical corner of the enlarged housing.

major_faces.name: Rear end wall
major_faces.description: Broad planar end surface at the extreme rear of the part.

major_faces.name: Rear upper vertical round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical outer patch rounding the opposite rear vertical corner.

major_faces.name: Outer rear side wall
major_faces.description: Large planar side face across the enlarged rear body.

major_faces.name: Rear bottom panel
major_faces.description: Broad planar bottom surface of the enlarged housing.

major_faces.name: Longitudinal lower housing round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical patch blending the rear end wall into the housing bottom.

major_faces.name: Compound lower corner
major_faces.description: Spherical corner patch joining three mutually transverse rear-housing surfaces.

major_faces.name: Lower transverse housing round
major_faces.description: Cylindrical lower edge patch running across part of the rear housing width.

major_faces.name: Housing-to-spine side round
major_faces.description: Large cylindrical transition surface on the side of the housing near the spine junction.

major_faces.name: Rear shoulder wall
major_faces.description: Planar shoulder surface marking the step between the enlarged rear housing and the narrower spine.

Section.name: Blind axial socket
Section.function intent: Receives and radially locates a cylindrical mating pin, shaft, or tool inserted through the front terminal face.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical wall provides distributed radial bearing contact and constrains transverse translation of a mating member. The closed end provides an axial stop, while the surrounding spine and nose carry resulting bearing and insertion loads.
Section.geometry: Long blind cylindrical cavity aligned with the principal length direction. It opens through the front nose and terminates at a flat circular internal end near the rear end of the spine.
Section.location: Inside the main spine, extending longitudinally from the front terminal opening toward the rear housing.

major_faces.name: Socket cylindrical wall
major_faces.description: Long internal cylindrical surface forming the radial locating and bearing wall of the blind socket.

major_faces.name: Socket closed end
major_faces.description: Circular planar internal face closing the socket and providing an axial insertion stop.

Section.name: Lateral clearance and latch pocket
Section.function intent: Provides localized clearance or an engagement space for a latch, clip, slider, or mating projection approaching from the side of the spine.
Section.physical behavior: The pocket removes material to admit a mating feature while its opposed walls laterally locate that feature. The internal end wall limits insertion, and the remaining surrounding spine carries load around the opening.
Section.geometry: Rectangular or slightly stepped recess cut laterally into one side of the central spine. It contains two longitudinal side walls, a transverse inner wall, and opposed planar upper and lower surfaces.
Section.location: Inside the central spine, offset to one lateral side and positioned between the rear housing and front nose.

major_faces.name: Pocket first side wall
major_faces.description: Planar longitudinal wall forming one side boundary of the lateral pocket.

major_faces.name: Pocket upper face
major_faces.description: Broad planar internal surface forming the upper boundary of the recess.

major_faces.name: Pocket inner end wall
major_faces.description: Transverse planar wall closing the inner end of the pocket and limiting mating-part travel.

major_faces.name: Pocket second side wall
major_faces.description: Planar wall opposite the first side wall, providing the second lateral locating boundary.

major_faces.name: Pocket lower face
major_faces.description: Planar internal floor forming the lower boundary of the lateral recess.
